title: Exact Guarantees and Accelerated Algorithms for Chronos-Pathways in Go: A Balanced Search & Indexing Approach
topic: Exact guarantees and faster algorithms for k-rollercoasters
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present a deterministic algorithmic framework for computing the longest subsequence of a numeric stream that contains at most $k$ direction changes, a problem that underpins efficient path planning in Chronos-Pathways. The core contribution is a dynamic-programming formulation that achieves an $O(n^{2}k)$ time bound and $O(\text{nk})$ space bound while preserving strict height-balance and key-ordering invariants of an implicit balanced search structure. The Go implementation exploits contiguous node layout and pointer indirection to minimize allocation overhead. Formal invariants are proven using a simple inductive argument, and the algorithm's correctness is verified through automated AST inspection and structural profiling on an Intel Xeon 6975P-C platform. The source code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/go-concurrency-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261122_090154_exact_guarantees_and_faster_al}.
